plainLanguage: Section 48 inahusu kusaidia enemy prisoner of war kutoroka kwa kujua na kwa makusudi, na pia negligently au unlawfully kuruhusu escape ya mtu huyo.
meaning: Paragraph (a) criminalises knowing and advised assistance to escape by an enemy prisoner of war in the circumstances stated; paragraph (b) separately covers negligent or unlawful permission of such escape.
keyPoints: Paragraph (a) requires knowingly and advisedly aiding escape.
It covers confinement in prison or elsewhere and specified parole circumstances.
Paragraph (b) separately addresses negligent or unlawful permission of escape.

legalTerms.meaning: Enemy of the United Republic mwenye status ya prisoner of war katika context ya section.
Hali inayotajwa ambapo prisoner ameruhusiwa kuwa at large subject to parole.
